finalSayRing.line: You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

💛 You hold Carpenter's square. Your first solo frame, checked and found true. The nod that followed was the whole ceremony. Measure twice, cut once — it's in your hands now. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

Travel 1 tile to grove.
— Nut trees —
The canopy here is a roof built by a thousand architects who never met. Light comes through in coins.
Some of these unknown nuts are starting to look familiar — sort them at camp in good light and the name might come to you.
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 3× unknown nuts. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
(The snare wire becomes the snare — improvised, 2 uses.)
You set a Snare here. Check it tomorrow.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Movement — a bobcat, tufted ears, watching you with yellow eyes.
👁 It is hunting you. Don't run — that invites the chase. Hold your ground, strike true, or wear the claws.
Taken: Gland sac x1, Stripped hide x1, Big Ugly (carcass) x1.
The body is stripped. What's left isn't worth taking.
Sleeping rough means the cold ground — heal ~16.
You settle into the cold ground. Sleep takes you.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Terms of Service gorges at the treeline — 400 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
That night, they bring Ramandeep home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.

⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
⚠ Haven's pantry is empty. Day 1 of hunger.

Emberhold's speaker sent a runner: the southwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
— DAY 56 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
💬 Somchai whispers: "Someone's been leaving food out, and Wren won't admit a thing. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."
🛟 Someone by the fire stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch the empty bins happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Half rations for three days, voted and held — or a hard hunt now, hungry, to fill the bins before it's choosing-who-eats."
"Or we rally," Someone by the fire adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
Freezing — -4°C, and the roll didn't even call it cold. (-12 kcal shivering. Fire, the hall, or your tent.)
Your stomach is a fist. Eat — anything real, now.
Dawn. You wake stiff and cold. (+16 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 682 kcal conserved. Exposed. You'll wake stiff.)
Nothing edible. (Big Ugly (carcass), Gray Squirrel (trapped), unknown nuts — not food yet: A carcass. Clean it with a knife — quickly. Spoils fast..)
Need a fire to boil water.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
Drank clean water.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.

You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.

🌙 The night shift is out: Big Ugly and The Ugly Beast. They own the dark — the cast turns over after sunset, and every step is riskier. A lit fire is a beacon — light through canvas, smoke on the wind. Sealed and dark, you're just a smell in the night. Your night eyes read the dark — sometimes you slip away first. Haven's walls end every argument.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
